\caption{Eight-cell embedding ablation on \emph{first-average} (KuaiRec, $\lambda=0.01$, big-matrix protocol). The backbone (TRIER-PT, no RT augmentation here) is \emph{notype}: only ID embeddings. \textbf{type} adds the RecFormer-style learnable category embeddings, \textbf{author} the per-item creator embeddings, and \textbf{music} the per-item audio embeddings; full PACER combines all three. CS@20 is the average similarity of adjacent items in the list, and MaxRun@20 is the length of the longest contiguous segment of mutually similar items ($1 = $ no adjacent repetition; $20 = $ the whole list is repetitive). Best HR/NDCG/ILD/CC values per block are \textbf{bold}; for CS@20 and MaxRun@20 lower is better so their best is also bold.}
